sentimento.text1: With 68 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), Tuesday brought no national polling and brought state-level polling in three states, which changes the question the panel can answer. [Genial/Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) released rounds in Minas Gerais and Pernambuco (fieldwork Jul 22 to 26), and Real Time Big Data released Rio de Janeiro (fieldwork Jul 23 to 27). None of them enters the panel's national set, by scope rule, and all three say the same thing about the country: the race is geographically split. In Pernambuco, Lula has 55% against 21% for Flávio in the first round (n=900, 3pp margin, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) filing BR-03810/2026). In Minas, it is a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both rounds: 30% to 29% in the first, 38% to 35% against Flávio in the runoff, and Zema numerically ahead of Lula by 39% to 37% (n=1,482, 3pp margin, BR-09333/2026). In Rio, Flávio leads by 46% to 42% in the runoff (n=2,000, BR-06074/2026).
sentimento.text2: The most direct cross-reading of the day did not come from a poll, it came from a sentence. Felipe Nunes, CEO of [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), said at the Lide business luncheon in São Paulo that Lula's chance of re-election stands at 60%, against 38% at the start of the year, in a model that ties government approval to re-election probability. [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket), over the same period, is at 63.50%. It is the first time in this panel that the two sources estimate the SAME quantity, probability of victory, rather than different quantities: normally the panel compares implied probability with voting intention, which are not the same thing. The distance between the two estimates is 3.50pp. Recording that is not saying one validates the other: they are two models with different assumptions that landed close, and landing close is not proof of being right.
sentimento.text3: In the market, Lula returned to 63.50% (vol USD 7.69M), up 1.00pp, and MATCHES the ceiling of the AFOS series, which was marked on Jul 26 at 22:30 UTC. It is not a new high, it is the same high touched again. The gap over Flávio went to +39.65pp, below the widest gap in the series, which is +39.80pp, from those same early hours of Jul 26. Flávio held at 23.85% (vol USD 7.69M) for a second session. The one moving the other way was Renan Santos, down 0.80pp to 8.75% (vol USD 8.58M), losing the 9% handle. And the strongest move of the day was again in third place in the first round: Caiado went from a range of 19.00% to 19.50% up to 26.50%, while Renan fell from 62.00% to 60.50%. Over two sessions, Caiado went from 15.50% to 26.50% in that book. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 116.26M. The double-reading lock PASSED today, with no divergence at all across the five books it covers, unlike yesterday's two blocked rounds.
sentimento.direita: Flávio held at 23.85% (vol USD 7.69M) in the winner contract for a second session, and rose 1.50pp in second place in the first round, to 78.00%. That is the exact inverse of yesterday, when he rose in the winner contract and fell in second place. In state polling, the day was good in Rio, where Real Time has him ahead of Lula by 46% to 42% in the runoff, and bad in Pernambuco, where [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) measures him at 21% against 55%. The cut Folha de S.Paulo published from the Jul 24 [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) poll shows the structural point: among women, Lula has 50% against his 40% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his rejection is the highest in that group. On the judicial front, he failed to appear for testimony at the Federal Police and sent a written defence to the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) in the inquiry into alleged slander against Lula, and Moraes ordered the PGR to weigh in on the cancelled testimony (G1, O Globo, Jul 28). He still has no running mate, with the Aug 5 deadline in view.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula rose 1.00pp to 63.50% (vol USD 7.69M) and again touched the ceiling of the AFOS series, marked on Jul 26. The gap over Flávio went to +39.65pp, still below the widest in the series, +39.80pp. There was no fresh national polling to test that level: the most recent is still [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Jul 27, with Lula at 42% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47% x 43% in the runoff. In the day's state polling he confirmed the Northeast, with 55% in Pernambuco, and looked vulnerable in Minas, where he is in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) with Flávio and trails Zema numerically by 39% to 37%. The scale counterpoint comes from Poder360, which compiled the published state polls and records Lula leading in 12 states against 7 for Flávio. Abroad, the government filed for consultations at the WTO against the US surcharges on Jul 27, and on Tuesday it was reported that Trump will extend the national emergency over Brazil by one year.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The chasing pack had another day of internal reallocation, again between Renan and Caiado. In third place in the first round, Caiado jumped from a range of 19.00% to 19.50% up to 26.50% and Renan fell from 62.00% to 60.50%. Over two sessions, Caiado added 11.00pp in that book, from 15.50% to 26.50%. But the winner contract did not follow: Caiado sat at 1.90% (vol USD 5.19M), down 0.05pp, which is a mixed signal and not a clean advance. The day's factual counterpoint came from Poder360: Caiado leads in Goiás, and Goiás is the only state where the third way looks competitive, worth 3.2% of the national electorate. National competitiveness measured in a runoff poll and geographic competitiveness concentrated in one state are different things, and the panel records both. Renan fell in ALL THREE books where he appears, which is different from yesterday's mixed signals: 8.75% in the winner contract, 12.15% in second place and 60.50% in third. Zema held at 0.55%, Michelle rose 0.05pp to 0.45% and Haddad stayed at 0.25%.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 63.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.69M), Flávio 23.85% (flat, vol USD 7.69M), Renan 8.75% (down 0.80pp, vol USD 8.58M), Caiado 1.90% (down 0.05pp, vol USD 5.19M), Jair 1.05% (flat, vol USD 5.26M), Zema 0.55% (flat, vol USD 4.55M), Michelle 0.45% (up 0.05pp, vol USD 9.32M), Camilo Santana 0.40% (flat), Haddad 0.25% (flat, vol USD 6.38M), Alckmin 0.25%, Tarcísio 0.15% (flat, vol USD 13.65M), Tereza Cristina 0.15%. Lula's gap over Flávio at +39.65pp, up 1.00pp against yesterday, below the widest gap in the series, which is +39.80pp on Jul 26. Sub-markets: second place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with Flávio at 78.00% (up 1.50pp) and Renan at 12.15% (down 0.50pp); third place with Renan at 60.50% (down 1.50pp), Caiado at 26.50% (up 7.00pp to 7.50pp against yesterday's range) and Flávio at 7.75% (flat). Senate by seats: [PL](/en/glossary#pl) at 71.00% (flat) and [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) at 17.25% (down 1.00pp). Impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice at 2.80% (down 0.60pp). Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 116.26M. Capture Jul 28 at 21:13 UTC, cleared by the double-reading lock with no divergence at all.

inss.text1: The fiscal agenda went a second day without fresh news: Senate in recess, priority bills stalled and promulgation of the [pauta-bomba](/en/glossary#pauta-bomba) still held back by Davi Alcolumbre. The economic axis of the day was external. It was reported that Trump will extend the national emergency over Brazil by one year, with the notice due in the Federal Register on Jul 29, keeping the July 2025 declaration in force. The extension is a requirement of the US National Emergencies Act and, on its own, creates no new sanction and reinstates no tariff, even though it is the legal basis for the surcharges. In parallel, the Lula government filed on Monday for consultations at the WTO against the recent surcharges.
inss.text2: The market moved at the top after two flat sessions: Lula rose 1.00pp and returned to 63.50%, matching the ceiling of the AFOS series marked on Jul 26. What does NOT explain that move matters: no fresh national poll came out on Tuesday. The day's three polls are state-level and do not measure the country. When the price moves with no fresh polling to anchor it, the correct reading is that the market reacted to something else, and the panel cannot say to which, because the same session carried the extension of the US emergency, the WTO filing, three state polls and the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) CEO's remark on re-election probability. Recording the absence of an anchor is more honest than picking a cause.
inss.text3: The market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice FELL 0.60pp to 2.80% (vol USD 83 thousand), breaking four days of near-total stillness. The methodological caveat still counts for more than the number: with USD 83 thousand in accumulated volume against USD 116.26M in the presidential market, this book is orders of magnitude smaller and a move in it does not support a narrative. What is on the record is that the price moved DOWN on precisely the day it was reported that Kassio Nunes Marques has for four months been sitting on the writ that decides whether the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) congressional inquiry is installed, and that Fachin rejected, as filed out of time, the request by four senators to remove him from the case. The panel records the coincidence and asserts no cause.
inss.text4: Inflation carried the most striking change of the day in relative terms, and it needs two caveats before the number. The modal band flipped: 4.50% to 4.99% went to 39.25%, against 26.30% yesterday, and took the lead from the 5.00% to 5.49% band, which sat at 38.15%. The 5.50% to 5.99% band stood at 12.20%. In one sentence, the centre of the distribution stepped down one notch and came up against the ceiling of the inflation target, instead of sitting half a point above it. The caveats: the whole book adds up to USD 79 thousand, and the band that rose most has USD 12 thousand in accumulated volume. And, decisively, the inflation market is NOT covered by the double-reading lock, which watches only the five electoral books. That number did not go through the same verification as the others and enters with that warning.
inss.impactoLula: No fresh national approval reading on Tuesday. The most recent is still [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Jul 27: personal approval 47% against 49% disapproval, with 4% who did not answer, against 47% x 47% on Jul 13. The contrast with [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) of Jul 24 still stands, because there it was the reverse, 49% x 48%. Two surveys with a 2pp margin and two [statistical ties](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) with the ends swapped describe a narrow band around 48%, not a swing. The day's new data point on this theme is indirect and comes from the sector itself: Felipe Nunes, CEO of [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), said at the Lide event that, in the model tying government approval to re-election probability, Lula's chance rose from 38% at the start of the year to 60% now, tracking approval from 43% to 47%. The earlier readings: PoderData Jul 22 at 46% x 47%, Indexa Jul 21 at 49% x 48%, Real Time Jul 21 at 46% x 50%, Genial/Quaest Jul 15 at 48% x 47% and PoderData/Aya Jul 16 at 42% x 51%.
inss.impactoGestao: No fresh national reading on the administration's performance on Tuesday. The most recent is still [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Jul 27, with 43% poor or terrible (9% poor and 34% terrible) against 36% excellent or good (15% excellent and 21% good) and 20% average. [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) of Jul 24 had 32% x 38% x 28%. The two institutes disagree on the level and agree on the sign: voters approve of the person more than they approve of the administration. In inflation, the market changed its modal band: 4.50% to 4.99% sat at 39.25%, ahead of the 5.00% to 5.49% band at 38.15% and the 5.50% to 5.99% band at 12.20% ([Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket)). The centre of the distribution came up against the ceiling of the target instead of sitting above it, in a book adding up to USD 79 thousand that does not pass through the capture lock.
inss.conclusao: With 68 days to the election, Tuesday inverted Monday. On Monday there was national polling and the favourite's price stood still. On Tuesday there was no national polling and the price rose 1.00pp, returning to the ceiling of the series. The day's three polls are state-level and tell a story the national average hides: Lula at 55% in Pernambuco, a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in Minas with Zema numerically ahead in the runoff, and Flávio ahead in Rio by 46% to 42%. The race is geographically split, and Poder360 records Lula leading in 12 states against 7 for Flávio, with Goiás the only one where the third way looks competitive and worth 3.2% of the electorate. In the market, the third-place realignment continued: Caiado went to 26.50% and Renan fell in all three books where he appears. And [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel), which had publication declared to the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for today with n=5,000, was not released by the close of this capture.

bancoMaster.text1: Tuesday brought fresh procedural news on two fronts, and neither is yesterday's. The first is investigative: Valor Econômico published an exclusive report that André Mendonça authorised the Federal Police to trace abroad the assets of Daniel Vorcaro and others involved in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case. The panel records the information with explicit attribution to the outlet, because it is one newsroom's exclusive reporting and not a ruling published on a court portal, and does not treat it as confirmed by a second source.
bancoMaster.text2: The second front is legislative, and there the news is the delay. O Globo and Tribuna da Internet reported that Kassio Nunes Marques has for four months been sitting on the writ that decides whether the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) congressional inquiry is installed in the Senate. Four senators, Eduardo Girão, Alessandro Vieira, Marcos Pontes and Plínio Valério, asked for his removal from the case, citing delay on a matter of constitutional urgency and a public relationship with Ciro Nogueira. Edson Fachin rejected the request because it was filed outside the deadline in the Court's rules, without ruling on the merits of the claim. In parallel, the justice minister refused to lift the secrecy on Vorcaro's visits to the Federal Police.
bancoMaster.text3: On price, the record is the usual one and bears repeating: the market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice fell 0.60pp to 2.80%, in a book of USD 83 thousand. The fall happened on the same day as that news, and the panel does NOT attribute one to the other. A book that size moves on very little money, and the same Tuesday carried the extension of the US emergency, three state polls and a strong move in third place in the presidential market. Asserting cause here would invent precision the data does not have.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The two fronts of the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case remain on separate tracks and should not be added together: the criminal one, at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) under Mendonça, now with asset tracing abroad according to Valor, and the civil one, in the Rio courts, with a freeze of up to R$ 135 million already set. Tuesday's structural novelty is a third: the legislative route has been stalled for four months at the Court, and the attempt to unblock it by removing the reporting justice was rejected on a deadline question, not on the merits. When the parliamentary route stays dammed behind a ruling that never comes, the cost does not show up in a market price, it shows up in time.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) crisis, with no new individual ruling captured on Tuesday.
stf.moraes: He acted again rather than merely being named. He ordered the PGR to weigh in on Flávio Bolsonaro's cancelled testimony in the inquiry into alleged slander against Lula, after the senator failed to appear at the Federal Police and sent a written defence arguing that Lula again linked him to traitors of the homeland and mentioned hanging (G1, O Globo, CartaCapital, Jul 28). He also gave Daniel Silveira 48 hours to explain a campaign video recorded alongside Carlos Portinho (VEJA, Jul 28). Abroad, Javier Milei's attack on him at the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention drew a formal response from judges' and lawyers' associations on Tuesday.
stf.gilmar: No individual ruling from Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, alongside Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which eased restrictions on [penduricalhos](/en/glossary#penduricalhos), a theme back in the economic news on Tuesday over the bill for interest on arrears.
stf.dino: No individual ruling from Dino captured on Tuesday. He remains a target of the Bolsonaro camp, and the recent joint vote on [penduricalhos](/en/glossary#penduricalhos) stands, with the budget dispute still open at the Court.
stf.mendonca: The most active front of the day in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case. Beyond remaining the reporting justice in the inquiry opened on Jul 23 into Vorcaro's payments for the film about Jair Bolsonaro, Valor Econômico published an exclusive report on Jul 28 that he authorised the Federal Police to trace abroad the assets of the former banker and others involved. The information enters attributed to the outlet, with no independent second source by the close of this capture.
stf.nexo: Tuesday's through-line moved from the campaign platform to the courtroom. Abroad, it was reported that Trump will extend the national emergency over Brazil by one year, with the notice due in the Federal Register on Jul 29, which keeps the legal basis for the surcharges in place without creating a new sanction, while the Brazilian government filed on Monday for consultations at the WTO. Judges' and lawyers' associations responded formally to Milei's attack on Moraes. At home, Moraes brought in the PGR over Flávio's cancelled testimony, and the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) congressional inquiry route has been dammed for four months in Kassio Nunes Marques's chambers, with Fachin rejecting as out of time the request by four senators to remove him.
stf.analise: The market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice before 2027 FELL 0.60pp to 2.80% (vol USD 83 thousand), breaking four near-flat days. The methodological caveat comes before the reading: with USD 83 thousand in accumulated volume against USD 116.26M in the presidential market, a move in this book does not support a narrative and today's drop could be one small order, not a repricing. With that said, the record is that the price moved down on the Tuesday when institutional news was denser than the day before: the PGR brought in by Moraes over Flávio's testimony, judiciary associations responding formally to a foreign head of state attacking a justice, and the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) congressional inquiry stalled for four months behind a writ that goes unjudged. Real money kept treating all of it as institutional friction, and on Tuesday priced slightly LESS removal risk than yesterday, not more.
